tasks.label: Solari: Start Web Server (Port 8080)
tasks.command: javac --release 17 -encoding UTF-8 -sourcepath src/main/java -d out/main src/main/java/com/solari/similarity/Main.java && java -cp out/main com.solari.similarity.Main --serve --port 8080

tasks.label: Solari: Run CLI Batch Triage
